steps.label: CoreDNS
steps.sub: a Deployment in kube-system every Pod queries

steps.label: Automatic
steps.sub: watches the API server — no manual DNS records

eyebrow: Every Service gets a predictable FQDN
code:
# <service-name>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local

curl http://checkout/                          # same namespace
curl http://checkout.default/                  # any namespace
curl http://checkout.default.svc.cluster.local/ # fully qualified
caption: Northbridge's code calls "checkout" by name — DNS resolves it to the Service's current ClusterIP.

eyebrow: Headless Service — one DNS record per Pod
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalog-db
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: catalog-db
  ports:
    - port: 5432
caption: clusterIP: None skips load-balancing — DNS returns every matching Pod's IP individually, the StatefulSet pattern.
